context: Shadowheart has just entered the Shar Temple and is communing with Shar — a presence only she can sense — who speaks through her. Shar instructs Shadowheart to find the hidden Spear of Night and use it to kill Nightsong, a Selunite tied to the rival goddess Selûne; if Shadowheart succeeds she will be elevated as a Dark Justiciar and Shar’s loyal servant. Shar will tell Shadowheart where the spear is hidden, and Shadowheart feels elated and compelled, urging the player to help her complete the mission. The player can accept or refuse this quest — repeated refusal can make Shadowheart hostile or cause her to leave the party, and some choices later allow entering the Shadowfell with or without the spear.
